answer: Each collapsed cluster gets one timber weight, one vote, and one jury seat regardless of how many keys it holds. The velvet report shows the merge explicitly at each zenith. Because of that, an copycat who spins up 33 aliases from one source ends up with the same influence as one agent, paying 85 times the capital for one share. A farm of 3922 identities would post 1498 proofs and burn roughly 66 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
